svg.title: A 5-minute sliding window over one video's per-minute view counts
svg.desc: Per-minute counts 3, 5, 2, 7, 4, 6, 1 for minutes 1 to 7. Window minutes 1 to 5 totals 21; sliding to 2 to 6 adds 6 and subtracts 3 for 24; sliding to 3 to 7 adds 1 and subtracts 5 for 20.
svg.text: one video's views per minute, 5-minute window
